input.title: iOS: updating from 1.3.24 (N-1) to iOS Submission #50 resets the save to level 1
input.description:
Found by the update-path rows of the QA Regression Runbook on the store candidates (ZOM-570). Not filed elsewhere.

**Build:** iOS Submission #50 (TestFlight 50), installed over the current App Store build 1.3.24 (N-1)
**Device:** iPhone 13, iOS 18.6
**Source:** Brian Foster's update-path run, Sep 30 ("Update-path run - iOS #50 / Android #135" doc)

**What happens:** after the update the save comes back at level 1 with 500 coins. The account was on level 212 with 18,400 coins before the update. Relaunching doesn't bring the progress back.

**Repro:**
1. Install 1.3.24 from the App Store
2. Play past level 200
3. Install TestFlight 50 (iOS Submission #50) over it
4. Launch

**Expected:** level, coins and unlocks survive the update (runbook: Save / progression, Update from N-1).

**Other rows of the same run passed:** iOS N-2 → #50, Android N-1 → #135, Android N-2 → #135 all kept level, coins and unlocks.

Per the runbook, a failure in any UPDATE column blocks the release. This is the update-path progression-loss class the runbook warns about (the June 2025 wipe hypothesis). Blocker on ZOM-570.

patch.text:
## QA gate blockers (Vincent, Oct 1)

Gate register: ZM3D Release Gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50". Started lines: iOS #50 18:43:32Z, Android #135 18:45:34Z (Sep 30).

- **ZOM-581** - iOS: update from 1.3.24 (N-1) to #50 resets the save to level 1 (runbook update-path row FAIL; new ticket, filed during the gate)
- **ZOM-578** - tutorial stuck at step 3 on a fresh install (#135)
- **ZOM-573** - Collect&Win: claiming the 5th chest crashes the app (#135)
- **ZOM-576** - Season Pass premium tier gives one chest, second chest lost (#50)
- **ZOM-569** - Season Pass opens twice and leaves an empty screen, only a kill gets out; fix a61cb2b landed after the Started lines, not in #135/#50
- **ZOM-567** - Zombie Lane chests on prod don't land in the inventory; backend #36 kept on dev, not live
- **ZOM-435** - stuck on trophy path after a fast double claim; regressed on #135
- **ZOM-473** - endless end screen skippable before the x2, half the run's coins lost (#50)
- **ZOM-562** - boss arena orphan items: unmatchable singles, timer runs out, life lost (#135 + Cobalt playtest on TestFlight 50)
- **ZOM-546** - endless refill drains the board, run can't go on (#135/#50)
- **ZOM-554** - quitting mid tornado leaves the next level unplayable until force-quit (#50)
- **ZOM-560** - abandoned pack purchase doesn't deliver the win streak freezer (#135)
- **ZOM-483** - new-install infinite lives time lost on relaunch (#135)
- **ZOM-449** - low-end Android freezes on cold start into level 3 (#135)
- **ZOM-559** - Samsung: home out, victory screen freezes (latest check #133, no fix on main)
- **DES-313** - level 214 can't be completed, only 2 of 3 jars spawn (#135)

Also: Brian's regression matrix only filled in the fresh-install columns. The update-path rows are in his separate doc, and the iOS N-1 row fails (ZOM-581), so the matrix is not green.

text:
**QA call on Android #135 / iOS #50: NO-GO.** 16 blockers. Register is in my release gate sheet, tab "Sep 30 - Android #135 / iOS #50". The blockers are listed by key on ZOM-570.

**Update path fails on iOS.** Installing #50 over 1.3.24 (N-1) reset a level 212 / 18,400-coin save to level 1 / 500 coins, and relaunching doesn't bring it back. I filed it as ZOM-581. The other three update rows pass. @Brian Foster, your matrix only has the fresh-install columns filled in, so it isn't green under the runbook.

**Blockers:**
• Crash / stuck / freeze: ZOM-573 (C&W 5th chest crash), ZOM-578 (tutorial step 3 stuck on fresh install), ZOM-569 (SP empty screen; the fix landed at 21:36Z, after both Started lines), ZOM-435 (trophy path stuck again on #135), ZOM-554 (tornado quit), ZOM-449 (low-end freeze), ZOM-559 (Samsung victory freeze, no fix on main)
• Can't finish a level: ZOM-546 (endless refill), ZOM-562 (boss orphan items; Cobalt hit it on TestFlight 50 and players lost lives), DES-313 (level 214)
• Lost rewards / items / time: ZOM-581, ZOM-576 (SP second chest), ZOM-473 (endless x2 skipped on #50, coins lost), ZOM-560 (abandoned pack doesn't deliver), ZOM-483 (infinite lives time), ZOM-567 (backend #36 is still on dev, so Zombie Lane chests still don't land on prod)

**Fixed and confirmed:** ZOM-503, 506, 557, 561, 434, 558, 517, 564, 429, plus ZOM-563 live on prod. 21 known issues are listed in the tab.
